details: Bitcoin has shown resilience, trading above $81,000 despite recent volatility, with spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) continuing to attract inflows for a third consecutive month. Analysts at JPMorgan suggest that Bitcoin is increasingly being favored over gold as a "debasement trade" in the wake of geopolitical events, highlighting a shift in investor preference for hedging against inflation and economic uncertainty.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $81K as JPMorgan Sees BTC Gaining Over Gold

details: Significant progress is being made on the Digital Asset Market Clarity (CLARITY) Act, a crucial US cryptocurrency bill aimed at establishing clearer regulations for digital assets. A compromise has reportedly been reached on stablecoin yield rules, and the White House's top crypto adviser is pushing for the bill's passage by July 4th, indicating a concerted effort to finalize federal crypto legislation.
title: US Crypto Bill Gains Momentum; White House Targets July 4 Deadline

details: The number of investors waiting to unstake Ethereum (ETH) has surged dramatically, reaching 352,136 ETH by May 5th. This increase is largely attributed to a series of Decentralized Finance (DeFi) exploits in April 2026, which led to approximately $625 million in stolen funds. Concurrently, Ethereum experienced a 2.88% decrease in its 24-hour trading, dropping below $2,300 USDT at one point on May 7th.
title: Ethereum Staking Queue Spikes Amid DeFi Exploit Concerns; ETH Sees Price Dip

details: TrustedVolumes, a liquidity provider and market maker for the 1inch decentralized exchange, has been exploited on the Ethereum network, resulting in approximately $6.7 million in wrapped assets and stablecoins being drained. This incident marks the fifth major DeFi breach in May 2026, underscoring ongoing security vulnerabilities within the decentralized finance sector.
title: 1inch Market Maker TrustedVolumes Suffers $6.7 Million DeFi Hack

details: Solv Protocol has announced its decision to transition from LayerZero to Chainlink for its $700 million tokenized Bitcoin operations. This strategic move highlights a growing preference for Chainlink's oracle solutions within the crypto ecosystem, emphasizing security and reliability for cross-chain functionalities and asset bridging.
title: Solv Protocol Migrates to Chainlink for $700 Million Tokenized Bitcoin

details: In its Q1 2026 rebalancing, Grayscale's Decentralized Finance (DeFi) Fund has added Ethena (ENA) to its holdings, assigning it a 13.59% weighting. This inclusion positions Ethena as the fourth-largest asset in the fund, signaling increasing institutional interest and a shift in investment strategies within the DeFi landscape.
title: Grayscale DeFi Fund Adds Ethena (ENA) to Its Portfolio
